title: floor lamp
text:
floor lamp. It comes disassembled. It took me about 20 minutes to twist all the segments together. The lamp I received is a matte black. The tubing is metal. The lamp is LED. There is a spot on the main tube of the lamp that is supposed to allow you to turn on the lamp and dim - it does not work. If you use the remote, you can use the toggle on the main tube to dim either the large or the mini lamp - but it will NOT turn the lamp on or off. The remote uses a really small barrel shaped battery (came with it) but looks like it will be hard to find. Eh. But the remote turns on and off both lights, dims them and changes the light from a blue or "warm" color light. The mini light has a goose neck that you can manipulate. The large light has two options, straight up and flat (pointing directly at the ceiling) or at a tilt (which I prefer for dust). I like the light, but disappointed that the main tube of the lamp doesn't work - not that I am terribly surprised it doesn't. It says to light tape the toggle - big nothing. You can tap, gently hold or bang it - NOTHING happens. Thus the 3 stars. TIP NOTE: because the tube is metal, and you have to twist the segments together, be SUPER careful to get them twisting correctly so you don't strip them or get them stuck at the wrong angle.
PROS: LED, doesn't flicker.
You can change the light from a white/blue to a warmer yellower light.
Dimmer option.
The mini light is nice if you read in bed or at the sofa.
CONS: You cannot turn the lamp on or off without the remote - even though you are supposed to be able to. Bad battery size - will be a pain to find replacement.
If I loose the remote, I will not be able to use the lamp. Eh.
